blocks.x: We talked about Wilbur Sweatman, and I asked you also about this Richard Chetman. Since I last spoke with you, do recall who this Chetman was? You were apparently with him just before you went with King Oliver, or around the time perhaps that you went with King Oliver. Richard Chetman. If you don't recall, I mean, it's no... You don't have to worry about it.
